description: This source file defines the WatchReplyCoordinator class, which manages reply events from a watch interface. It handles deduplication, queuing when the gateway is disconnected, and provides methods for ingesting events, draining queued events when connected, and requeuing events.

classes.name: WatchReplyCoordinator
classes.description: A class that manages reply events from a watch, including deduplication and queuing while disconnected.

methods.name: ingest
methods.description: Processes a WatchQuickReplyEvent, handles deduplication and queuing based on connection status.

methods.name: drainIfConnected
methods.description: Returns queued events if the gateway is connected, clearing the queue.

methods.name: requeueFront
methods.description: Reinserts an event at the front of the queue.

methods.name: queuedCount
methods.description: Returns the number of queued replies.
